To fix that you can add this CSS to your subverse or if you use the Stylish extension you can apply it to the whole website:

~~~ .drop-arrow + ul[style*="hidden"] { display: none; } .drop-arrow + ul[style*="visible"] { display: block; } ~~~

While in the Army I was responsible for the air defense of the National Capital Region (Washington DC). One day an unidentified radar contact showed up with an airspeed of 90 knots at 1000 feet. No transponder code.

Protocol was to scramble the F-16s out of Andrews so I did. The radar contact was right overhead of my location so I immediately went outside only to see a large flock of Canada Geese flying overhead.

They had a really big tailwind which made their speed appear so high.

I never said a word and smiled the whole time the fighters kept searching for the radar contact.
